title: session-predicate-guardrail-and-sealed-audit-tunnel
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds runtime-evaluated session predicate guardrails to RBAC v2 and a sealed audit envelope proxy that encrypts and signs audit payloads to reduce KMS exposure while preserving provenance. Backward compatible; opt-in via feature flag and staged rollout.
description: Context: Customers running private deployments requested stronger operator scoping controls and tamper-evident audit envelopes that limit direct KMS usage for high-volume telemetry. Motivation: Provide per-request, attribute-driven guardrails for ephemeral operator sessions and reduce KMS call volume and blast radius for audit export while keeping provable non-repudiation. What this PR does: 1) Adds a lightweight session predicate evaluator to the RBAC v2 path (service/authz/session_predicate.go) that evaluates request-scoped predicates expressed in CEL against request metadata (claims, route, region, model_id). Predicates can be asserted at binding time and enforced at decision time, enabling constraints like "operator may act on resources only when tenant.region == request.region and session.auth_level >= 2". 2) Introduces a sealed-audit-tunnel proxy (audit/proxy/sealed_envelope.go + audit/proxy/envelope_serializer.go) that batches audit records, encrypts payload blobs with a short-lived envelope key, and writes a small signed proof to the primary KMS instead of a full payload for each record. The proxy supports a fallback mode where the full audit payload is uploaded to object storage and only a KMS-signed commitment is stored in the audit ledger. 3) Adds a migration and rollout path: the new guardrail is behind feature flag "rbac_session_predicates", and the audit proxy is gated by "sealed_audit_tunnel". Both features are disabled by default and can be enabled per-namespace. 4) Observability: new metrics (authz.session_predicate_evaluations_total, audit.sealed_tunnel_enqueued, audit.kms_commitments_total) and traces for predicate eval latency and envelope lifecycle. 5) Tests and docs: unit tests for predicate combinators and integration tests simulating region-mismatch rejections, plus a docs page with examples (docs/security/session-predicates.md). Migration notes: existing RBAC bindings are unchanged; predicate fields are optional. Rollout plan: start with canary namespaces, monitor authz rejections and audit commit rate, then flip feature flag org-wide after 7 days of stable metrics. Checklist: - [x] Add predicate evaluator and parser - [x] Implement sealed audit envelope proxy and fallback - [x] Unit/integration tests - [x] Metrics, traces, and dashboards - [x] Docs and migration guide - [x] Feature flags and canary deployment Performance considerations: predicate evaluation is designed to be cheap (<0.5ms median) and short-circuits on common cases; audit proxy batches by time/size to amortize KMS calls. Security considerations: envelope keys are generated from a KMS-provisioned root and cached in memory with TTL; keys are zeroed after use to reduce in-memory exposure. Limitations: current envelope format (v0.3) is append-only and does not yet support multi-operator co-signing; follow-up work is tracked in ENG-2239. Commits summary: ["add: session predicate evaluator and CEL bindings","feat: sealed audit envelope proxy with batching and fallback","test: session predicate unit tests","docs: session predicates guide and audit envelope migration","chore: feature flag wiring and metrics"] Changed files (high level): ["service/authz/session_predicate.go","service/authz/predicate_parser.go","audit/proxy/sealed_envelope.go","audit/proxy/envelope_serializer.go","audit/proxy/tunnel_worker.go","docs/security/session-predicates.md","deploy/k8s/helm/values.yaml","integration-tests/test_session_predicates.sh","tests/audit_sealed_tunnel_test.go","pkg/metrics/metrics_definitions.go","pkg/tracing/audit_span_keys.go","cmd/featureflags/flags.go"] Testing performed: unit tests (CI), integration test harness on staging with synthetic tenants in eu-central and us-east, manual fault-injection to simulate KMS rate limit and object-storage fallback. Rollout and monitoring: feature flags added to the console; dashboards updated to include a small canary dashboard; alert thresholds set for predicate rejection rate >0.5% and KMS commitments surge. Related work and follow-ups: ENG-2239 (multi-operator co-signing), SEC-90 (audit envelope schema v1), SRE-310 (tune batching defaults).

review_thread: Liam O'Rourke: Can we get an estimate for added latency on the critical path? Suggested adding histogram buckets to authz decision spans.
Maya Chen: Added authz.predicate_eval_ms histogram and updated tracing to tag short-circuits; median is ~0.32ms in staging.

Sofia Alvarez: I like the sealed envelope approach but want clarity on KMS cost model when envelopes are high-frequency. Please add a note to docs and a safeguard to fall back to pure object-storage commit if KMS errors spike.
Maya Chen: Added KMS surge-detector and fallback; documented expected cost model and knob to tune batch size in docs.
Ethan Brooks: Tests look good; please add an integration case where multiple predicates are combined with AND/OR to ensure parser precedence. Also asked for a small performance benchmark.
Maya Chen: Added combined-predicate test and a microbench test in integration harness; added benchmark notes to ENG-2123.
